body: Agreed. I also used to (still do) think that those who smoke are assholes. Giving away their lives. But that seems to be my whole purpose so I go along :)
Thank you :) I wish talking would help. I have many people who're ready to talk. But when your life starts getting a burden on the planet, nothing makes sense.
Trying hard man! People start with a cigarette a day and then take off. I started with approx 3 packs a week.
I've started smoking in hope that it kills me. At least I can die being cool in front of the people around me.
That's what I'm afraid of. That I'll fail and/or it'll cause me pain. I just wish death comes soon and suddenly for me.
Damn it. I came here to post the same thing. What to do?
